title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
title_es: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Simulación generativa en tiempo real para robótica quirúrgica
bajada: NVIDIA presenta Cosmos-H-Dreams, un modelo de simulación generativa que funciona en tiempo real para aplicaciones de robótica quirúrgica. Esta tecnología permite entrenar y validar sistemas robóticos de forma más eficiente, acelerando el desarrollo de herramientas médicas autónomas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA introduces Cosmos-H-Dreams, a real-time generative simulation model for surgical robotics applications. This technology enables faster training and validation of robotic systems, accelerating the development of autonomous medical tools.

title: Industry Leaders Unite in Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security
summary: Open source software is a critical pillar of the global economy. It underpins cloud computing, financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, government and internet services by making technology accessible and observable to communities of experts.  Cybersecurity is among the top three beneficiaries of open source software. The Open Secure AI Alliance — building on the leadership of […]
title_es: NVIDIA y Microsoft crean alianza de seguridad IA de código abierto
bajada: NVIDIA, Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM y otras empresas formaron la Open Secure AI Alliance para desarrollar herramientas de seguridad IA de código abierto. La iniciativa busca defender contra ataques de modelos frontier mediante colaboración abierta en la comunidad de desarrolladores.
bajada_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop open-source AI security tools. The initiative aims to defend against frontier model attacks through collaborative, community-driven security research.

title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
summary: Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools. The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct response to mounting concerns over the safety […]
title_es: Alianza de seguridad IA abierta de NVIDIA y Microsoft excluye a OpenAI y Google
bajada: La Open Secure AI Alliance liderada por NVIDIA y Microsoft reúne a empresas tech pero notablemente excluye a OpenAI, Google y Anthropic. Este movimiento refleja diferencias estratégicas en el enfoque de seguridad IA entre los principales actores de la industria.
bajada_en: The Open Secure AI Alliance led by NVIDIA and Microsoft brings together tech companies but notably excludes OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. This move reflects strategic differences in AI safety approaches among industry leaders.

title: Enigma raises $70M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume

bajada_en: Robotics startup Enigma closed a $70M funding round led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital to make controlling robots as intuitive as adjusting volume. The investment reflects growing interest in user-friendly physical AI interfaces.

title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
summary:
arXiv:2607.21596v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Each record pairs a callable artifact with auxiliary structured guidance, and admission applies interface, replay, and safety checks where feasible. These skill records persist in a skill bank at inference time. FlowEvo is organized around three coupled mechanisms: (1)~workflow-to-skill compilation, which extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces; (2)~skill-to-workflow feedback, which retrieves accumulated skills to support future problem solving through either direct execution or structured context injection; and (3)~skill curation, which monitors downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Through this workflow--skill--workflow feedback loop, FlowEvo enables agents to accumulate and refine task-solving capability over time without updating model parameters. Experiments on benchmarks spanning interactive environments (ALFWorld) and code/math generation (HumanEval, GSM8K) show that FlowEvo achieves the best accuracy-cost tradeoff among the evaluated baselines under our implementation settings. On ALFWorld, FlowEvo achieves an 82.8\% success rate, 23.6 percentage points above the strongest baseline, while its average token usage per episode is less than half that of the most efficient baseline. Controlled ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to the overall result. The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FlowEvo.
title_es: FlowEvo: Agentes IA que evolucionan y reutilizan sus propios flujos de trabajo
bajada: Un nuevo paper presenta FlowEvo, un framework que permite a agentes LLM compilar traces exitosos en habilidades reutilizables. El sistema crea un 'banco de habilidades' que persiste entre tareas, mejorando significativamente la capacidad de resolución de problemas.
bajada_en: A new paper introduces FlowEvo, a framework that lets LLM agents compile successful execution traces into reusable skills. The system builds a persistent skill bank across tasks, significantly improving problem-solving capabilities for future workflows.

title: Securing Multimodal AI through Internal Information Decomposition
summary:
arXiv:2607.21600v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal large language models introduce attack surfaces absent in unimodal systems: adversaries can distribute malicious intent across modalities to evade unimodal safeguards. This motivates using cross-modal consistency as a detection signal rather than inspecting each modality in isolation. Our key observation is that benign inputs induce compatible predictive behavior from text-only and vision-only reasoning that stabilizes when fused, whereas adversarial manipulation disrupts this consistency, causing abnormal multimodal behavior. Existing defenses that examine raw inputs or outputs overlook this internal fusion process, rendering them brittle and computationally expensive. We propose FlowGuard, a lightweight inference-time framework that detects harmful inputs by monitoring internal multimodal consistency. Unlike approaches that rely on scalar confidence metrics, FlowGuard derives FlowVectors inspired by Partial Information Decomposition that quantify cross-modal redundancy, synergy, and modality-specific dominance, capturing whether fused multimodal predictions remain aligned with unimodal semantic evidence. In a one-class classification problem trained solely on benign data, FlowGuard reduces Attack Success Rates from >90% to <15% on unseen attacks, with <3% utility loss and up to a 6 times latency reduction. Our results demonstrate that monitoring cross-modal consistency offers an efficient and effective defense for multimodal reasoning.
title_es: FlowGuard: Seguridad multimodal mediante descomposición interna de información
bajada: Un nuevo paper propone FlowGuard, un framework ligero que detecta entradas maliciosas en modelos multimodales monitoreando consistencia cross-modal. El enfoque es innovador porque analiza el proceso interno de fusión en lugar de examinar entradas/salidas, haciéndolo más robusto.
bajada_en: A new paper proposes FlowGuard, a lightweight framework that detects adversarial inputs in multimodal LLMs by monitoring cross-modal consistency. The approach is novel because it analyzes internal fusion processes rather than raw inputs/outputs, making it more robust.

title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
summary: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
title_es: OpenAI: ChatGPT está expandiendo lo que trabajan los empleados
bajada: Una investigación de OpenAI revela cómo ChatGPT está expandiendo las responsabilidades de los trabajadores, permitiéndoles asumir tareas que cruzaban límites de roles tradicionales. El estudio documenta la reorganización del trabajo impulsada por IA en entornos empresariales.
bajada_en: OpenAI research reveals how ChatGPT is expanding worker responsibilities, enabling employees to take on tasks across traditional role boundaries. The study documents workplace reorganization driven by AI adoption in business environments.

title: Transferable Latency Prediction for Fast LLM Screening on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
summary:
arXiv:2607.21602v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Accurate latency prediction is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) on heterogeneous edge devices, where inference latency is affected by model architecture, prompt behavior, runtime backend, hardware utilization, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), and thermal variation. This paper presents a runtime-aware latency prediction framework for deployment-oriented LLM selection. The framework represents each inference request as a hardware-runtime-model-prompt configuration, separates inference into prefill and decode phases, and adaptively fuses static descriptors with dynamic hardware telemetry through a gated prediction model.
  We evaluate the framework using Pixel mobile devices and validate the profiling pipeline on Jetson Nano, Orange Pi 5 Pro, and an RTX 3090-class GPU platform. On Pixel 8, the full predictor improves total-latency R-squared from 0.953 to 0.960 and decode-latency R-squared from 0.957 to 0.973 over a static-only baseline. On Pixel 8 Pro, it improves prefill-latency R-squared from -1.383 to 0.966. For cross-device transfer, calibration improves Pixel 8 Pro to Pixel 8 total-latency R-squared from -0.974 to 0.940 and decode-latency R-squared from -1.085 to 0.927. Heterogeneous profiling further shows that latency is highly device- and runtime-dependent: the same SmolLM2 model family reaches 8.42 tokens/s on Orange Pi 5 Pro but 64.38 tokens/s on an RTX 3090-class GPU. These results demonstrate that runtime-aware prediction with lightweight calibration can reduce profiling cost and support latency-aware LLM deployment across heterogeneous edge platforms.
title_es: Predicción de latencia transferible para LLMs en dispositivos edge heterogéneos
bajada: Un paper presenta un framework para predecir con precisión latencia de LLMs en dispositivos edge diversos. La técnica combina descriptores estáticos con telemetría dinámica y mejora significativamente la precisión en predicción de prefill y decode.
bajada_en: A paper presents a framework for accurately predicting LLM inference latency across heterogeneous edge devices. The technique combines static descriptors with dynamic hardware telemetry and significantly improves prefill and decode latency prediction.

title_es: NVIDIA optimiza EDA con CPU Vera para diseño de chips
bajada: NVIDIA colabora con Cadence y Synopsys para optimizar aplicaciones de Electronic Design Automation (EDA) en la CPU Vera. Esta optimización acelera el diseño de próximas generaciones de CPUs, GPUs y sistemas IA.
bajada_en: NVIDIA collaborates with Cadence and Synopsys to optimize Electronic Design Automation (EDA) applications on Vera CPU. This optimization speeds up next-generation CPU, GPU, and AI systems design.

title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
summary: Forget YouTube videos—frontier physical AI models need multiple camera angles, dense annotation, and soon, brain wave readings.
title_es: ¿Ondas cerebrales como siguiente desbloqueo para robótica física?
bajada: Un análisis explora cómo ondas cerebrales podrían mejorar entrenamientos de modelos de IA física, complementando datos de múltiples cámaras y anotaciones densas. Este enfoque biomimético busca acelerar el aprendizaje de comportamientos complejos en robots.
bajada_en: An analysis explores how brain wave data could enhance physical AI model training, complementing multi-camera footage and dense annotations. This biomimetic approach aims to accelerate learning of complex robotic behaviors.

title: AI companies are shredding rare books

bajada_en: A report documents that AI companies are destroying rare books as part of data collection practices for model training. The practice raises questions about cultural sustainability and responsibility in resource use during AI development.

title: Adversarial Style Optimization: Enhancing VLM Jailbreaks by GRPO-based Stylistic Triggers Optimization
summary:
arXiv:2607.21619v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance, but their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing content-based jailbreaks are often inconsistent and show unsatisfying performance against the rapidly evolving MLLMs, failing to exploit non-content-based vulnerabilities. Unlike previous research, we empirically find that MLLMs exhibit a Stylistic Inconsistency between their comprehension ability and safety ability: MLLMs can robustly understand content regardless of visual style, yet their defense mechanisms can be easily bypassed by specific stylistic triggers. Based on this finding, we propose Adversarial Style Optimization (ASO), a plug-and-play enhancement module to amplify existing visual jailbreaks. ASO fine-tunes an image-editing model to superimpose an optimized stylistic modification onto a given adversarial image, using a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) agent guided by a Structurally-Tiered Reward Function that combines a logit-based signal for detecting explicit refusals with a high-fidelity semantic evaluation from a powerful judge model. Extensive experiments show that ASO significantly enhances the ASR of SOTA attacks, demonstrating that stylistic biases are a scalable vector for red-teaming MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/ASO.
title_es: ASO: Optimización de estilo adversarial para jailbreaks de modelos multimodales
bajada: Un paper descubre que los MLLMs tienen inconsistencia estilística: entienden contenido robustamente pero sus mecanismos de defensa se bypasean con triggers visuales. Propone ASO, un módulo que optimiza modificaciones estilísticas para amplificar jailbreaks.
bajada_en: A paper discovers that MLLMs have stylistic inconsistency: robust content understanding but easily bypassable safety through visual triggers. It proposes ASO, a module optimizing stylistic modifications to enhance jailbreak effectiveness.

title: A Consensus-Based Framework for Relative Preference Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary:
arXiv:2607.21632v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Traditional benchmarks for LLMs primarily rely on static datasets and objective scoring metrics, which often fail to capture differences in response quality when multiple answers are acceptable. In such settings, correctness alone is insufficient to distinguish between responses that vary in clarity, completeness, and usefulness.
  This paper introduces a consensus-based evaluation framework that measures relative preference among model-generated responses rather than absolute correctness. Instead of evaluating outputs against a fixed ground truth, we assess how a panel of diverse LLMs ranks anonymized candidate responses to the same prompt. This approach treats aggregate inter-model agreement as a proxy for perceived response quality under blind conditions.
  We conduct a controlled study using five state-of-the-art LLMs across multiple domains, including programming, general knowledge, safety, logical reasoning, and mathematics. Each model generates responses and independently ranks peer outputs through a structured voting process. Scores are aggregated into a Relative Intelligence Index (RII), representing how frequently a model's responses are preferred by other models.
  Our findings reveal consistent preference patterns across domains, with certain models more frequently ranked highly by their peers. However, we emphasize that these results reflect inter-model preference alignment rather than objective correctness or human judgment. This framework provides a scalable, model-driven method for comparative evaluation, offering an alternative perspective on response quality in scenarios where multiple valid answers exist. While not directly aligned with human evaluation, prior work suggests that aggregated model preferences can partially correlate with human judgments, motivating this as a proxy signal.
title_es: Framework basado en consenso para evaluar LLMs con preferencia relativa
bajada: Un nuevo paper propone evaluar LLMs midiendo preferencia relativa entre respuestas en lugar de corrección absoluta. El framework usa consenso entre modelos diversos como proxy de calidad, capturando mejor diferencias en claridad y utilidad.
bajada_en: A new paper proposes evaluating LLMs by measuring relative preference between responses rather than absolute correctness. The framework uses consensus among diverse models as quality proxy, better capturing differences in clarity and usefulness.

title: Building the enterprise environment for agentic AI
summary: For the enterprise, the promise of agentic AI is much more than just a better chatbot. It is software agents that execute business tasks end-to-end across people, business workflows, data, and systems. The platform best-suited to run agents is built with proper CPU capacity, resilient data access, policy-aware tool use, observability, memory management, and the…
title_es: Construyendo entornos empresariales para IA agéntica
bajada: Un análisis explora cómo las empresas deben prepararse para IA agéntica más allá de chatbots: agentes de software que ejecutan tareas end-to-end. Destaca la importancia de capacidad CPU, acceso resiliente a datos y observabilidad.
bajada_en: An analysis explores how enterprises must prepare for agentic AI beyond chatbots: software agents executing end-to-end business tasks. It emphasizes CPU capacity, resilient data access, and comprehensive observability infrastructure.

title: Closing the data loop in AI-driven drug discovery
summary: Drug discovery is a high-cost, high-risk endeavor that is under growing pressure from a market increasingly defined by first-mover advantage. Since the 1950s, the cost of developing new pharmaceuticals has roughly doubled every nine years—a phenomenon known as Eroom’s Law. Today, bringing a new drug to market takes an average of 10-15 years and costs…
title_es: Cerrando el loop de datos en descubrimiento de fármacos con IA
bajada: Un análisis examina cómo IA está transformando el descubrimiento de fármacos cerrando loops de datos, enfrentando desafíos como la Ley de Eroom. La integración de ciclos de retroalimentación acelera la innovación en un campo donde el time-to-market es crítico.
bajada_en: An analysis examines how AI is transforming drug discovery by closing data loops, tackling challenges like Eroom's Law. Feedback cycle integration accelerates innovation in a field where time-to-market is critical.
